Description: Monterey is a scenic coastal California city home to the Presidio of Monterey and the Defense Language Institute, the Naval Postgraduate School, and Naval Support Activity Monterey (nearby Fort Ord closed under BRAC in 1994). It offers a VA-DoD outpatient clinic in adjacent Marina, mild fog-cooled summers, Costco and Walmart access, and a strong military-education presence. The dominant tradeoff is cost: a typical home exceeds $1.1 million and California only partially exempts military retirement pay.
